Bundled devkitSMS artifacts (public domain — Unlicense; crt0 is GPL2 with the
standard linking "special exception"). Source: https://github.com/sverx/devkitSMS

Pinned commit: b172c7433ff690136fee47504a5fd427f62f2d16  (2026-07-02)

IMPORTANT: SMSlib.h, SMSlib.lib, PSGlib.lib and crt0_sms.rel here form ONE
mutually-consistent set built for the modern SDCC __sdcccall(1) convention and
REQUIRE SDCC >= 4.2. Never mix this SMSlib.lib with a different-version
SMSlib.h: several APIs (e.g. SMS_addSprite) changed shape and calling
convention between releases, producing "undefined _SMS_addSprite" or silent
ABI corruption. When building an EXISTING project that vendors its own SMSlib,
use that project's own header+lib together instead of these.

Files:
  SMSlib.lib      SMS/GG main library (link last-but-one)
  SMSlib_GG.lib   Game Gear build of SMSlib (use with -DTARGET_GG)
  PSGlib.lib      PSG music + SFX replayer (link last)
  crt0_sms.rel    startup / IRQ vectors for SMS (link FIRST, --no-std-crt0)
  SMSlib.h        header — must match SMSlib.lib (this version)
  PSGlib.h        header for PSGlib
  peep-rules.txt  SDCC Z80 peephole rules (--peep-file)
  ihx2sms.c       .ihx -> .sms converter (pads + fixes checksum); build w/ gcc
  folder2c.c      folder -> C const arrays (data.c/.h); build w/ gcc
  assets2banks.py rich asset->bank packer (alternative to folder2c)
